walkthrough.title: Get started with Orquestivo
walkthrough.description: Inspect CI/CD pipelines before pushing changes.
walkthrough.analyze.title: Analyze workflows
walkthrough.analyze.description: Open a trusted workspace and run **Orquestivo: Analyze CI/CD pipelines**.
config.maxFiles: Maximum number of pipeline files per scan.
config.maxFileBytes: Maximum size in bytes of one pipeline file.
config.level: How much detail the Control Center shows. The data is the same at every level.
config.level.beginner: Plain explanations and what to do.
config.level.advanced: Adds rule codes, categories, evidence and documentation links.
config.level.expert: Adds verification state, raw metadata and active policies.
config.remote: Allow reading recent GitHub Actions runs as remote evidence (opt-in, read-only, needs your token). User setting only.
config.ai: Enable the optional AI helper. No provider is bundled, so nothing is sent. User setting only.
capabilities.untrusted: Pipeline analysis, generation and remote evidence require a trusted workspace.
capabilities.virtual: Static pipeline analysis works in virtual workspaces.
